name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, regarding today... would it be alright if I left early?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As long as it gets done in the end, it's all good!!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the type to do your summer homework on the very last day, aren't you, Nanaka.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm terribly sorry for the trouble. Well then, goodbye.」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder if something happened to Lolotte?」

name: Synn
message: 「She did seem a little down, didn't she.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe my overly cheerful goodbye had the opposite effect~」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope I can be of some help to her, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte is always so proactive, after all. Seeing her this passive kind of throws me off.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right. That's why I figured I'd wait until Lolotte feels ready to talk.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's not true. Wait, please don't treat me like a kid!\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「No, Synn. That's not how I meant it--」
What is this? I have a bad feeling....

name: Lolotte
message: 「After the terrible things I've done... it's only natural, isn't it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to... apologize to Amyrina... and then--」

name: Arden
message: 「I came to pay you back for last time.」

name: Arden
message: 「Trying to catch me off guard again, huh? Well, that won't work!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry, but I don't have time to deal with you right now.」

name: Arden
message: 「Whoa there. Don't tell me you're planning to run away.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am not! I have important business to attend to.」

name: Arden
message: 「Then defeat me first before you go!」

name: Arden
message: 「You dared to ignore Arden of the Roar, feared as one of the Seven Demon Generals!?」

name: Arden
message: 「You've pissed me off. You're gonna regret this soon! Wishing you'd just fought me like a good girl!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hah... hah... I made it in time...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Are you alright? Are you hurt at all?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the young ladies' safety to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Arden
message: 「A pistol? Stuff like that won't work on me. Who the hell do you think I am? One of the dreaded Seven Demon Generals--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Ngh, an RPG would damage the academy...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-It's alright. Please, leave it to me.」

name: Arden
message: 「Hey, hold on! Listen properly when someone's introducing themselves!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm the one who will protect Amyrina!!」

name: Arden
message: 「Heh heh heh, finally in the mood, are you?」

name: Arden
message: 「Gwahahaha. Makes me happy... Rather than a helpless target, I need you to struggle at least a little.」

name: Arden
message: 「It's way more refreshing when I crush you that way!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「S-So strong... He only intimidated me, yet... my body won't move...!」

name: Arden
message: 「You had some other friends with you, right? If I've gotta deal with them too, that means--」

name: Synn
message: 「My hunch paid off. Are you hurt?」
A bullet was lodged deep in Arden's pinky toe.
Even with his tough physique, getting hit there hurt. Thanks to that, Arden's attack had softened.

name: Synn
message: 「Look who hasn't learned his lesson... Come back to get beaten again?」

name: Arden
message: 「Bastard! I just let my guard down last time! This time, I don't have a single opening.」

name: Arden
message: 「Zipper's up, too... Alright! Now I don't have a single opening.」
